raw:
Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: They extracted Survivor “winners” by grabbing any linked names from tables that merely contained a “Winner” header, instead of targeting the specific Winner column per season. This over-inclusive scraping pulled in non-winner names and inflated the count to 67, which exceeds the logical maximum of 44 seasons (with only two repeat winners). They then accepted this number without sanity-checking against known constraints, propagating the error to the final result.
